teaching_language: Depends on the host programme: French or English (a French certificate is asked for French-taught programmes)

milestones.label: 2027 call opens (French institutions nominate candidates)
milestones.source_text: Campus France's Eiffel page (official) gives October 2026 as the opening of the 2027 call. Students cannot apply directly; French institutions submit the files.

milestones.label: Application deadline (institutions' files received by Campus France)
milestones.source_text: Campus France's Eiffel page (official) sets this as the deadline for files to reach Campus France; universities set earlier internal deadlines, for example 20 November 2026 at one university.

milestones.label: Results published
milestones.source_text: Campus France's Eiffel page (official) says results are published from 12 April 2027.
